text:
Sam: Found a tiny poinsettia by the sink this morning looking like it might tap out soon. Left it on the sunny ledge with a note 'Please adopt?' :poinsettia:
Priya: Aww rescue mission. I vote we start a tiny adoption chain so it always has a human buddy over the break. Who can take it first? :raised_hands:
Jamie: I can grab it at lunch and give it a quick soak. My desk has a little lamp for emergency plant triage.
Nora: If it's still shaky after Jamie, I can foster it Friday-Sunday. My apartment is basically a plant hospice. :seedling:
Leo: I have a travel mug full of spare soil and a mini mister in my drawer if needed. Also proposing a ridiculous mitten/ugly-sweater poll to celebrate the handoff. Thoughts? :sweater:
Sam: Love both ideas. OK plan: Jamie picks up at 12:30, does a watering check, posts a pic. Nora is standby for weekend care. Leo brings soil/mister if Jamie wants it.
Priya: Poll time then: should we do "Office Mitten Showdown" on Thursday (bring your most ridiculous mittens) or a "Cozy Mug Parade"? React with :one: for mittens, :two: for mug parade.
Jamie: Picked it up. Plant looks thirsty but salvageable. Photo attached on thread (tiny red leaves). I bottom-watered it for 10m. Leaving a sticky note with watering rhythm: "small sip every 3 days".
Nora: Yay plant update. If it needs more light I'll bring it to my window Friday. Also mittens for the win :one:
Leo: Reacted :one: but also will bring my ridiculous snowman mug just in case :mug_with_steam:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Thu 15:45 in #random — "Office Mitten Showdown & Poinsettia photo-op" :white_check_mark:
Priya: This is the best non-work chain ever. Whoever ends up adopting it for home, we will officially rename it "Tiny Holly" unless vetoed.
Sam: Veto denied. Tiny Holly it is. Huge thanks everyone for the quick help and holiday vibes. :sparkles: :heart:
